purpose: silver_flights cleans the bronze nyc_flights capture into a flight-level fact table of 2013 domestic flight departures and arrivals from NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), ready to feed delay analytics and on-time performance dashboards.
usage: Consumers should treat each row as one scheduled flight departure identified by year, month, day, carrier, flight, and sched_dep_time; join on tailnum with awareness that about 0.9% of rows carry a null tailnum, and explicitly account for nulls in dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time (roughly 3% null each) when computing delay or duration metrics.
limitations: The cleanup could not resolve why dep_time, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time are null for roughly 3% of rows (4,883 to 5,480 of 166,158) since bronze carries no cancellation flag; those rows are retained with nulls rather than dropped or imputed, and year is single-valued (2013) so it contributes no discriminating power to the declared grain.
